title: Come, Sing a Song of Harvest

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Come, sing a song of harvest, Of thanks for daily food!
To offer God the first-fruits is old as gratitude.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Long, long ago, the reapers, before they kept the feast,
Put first-fruits in a basket, and took it to the priest.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Shall we, sometimes forgetful oh where creation starts,
With science in our pockets lose wonder from our hearts?

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: May God, the great Creator, to whom all life belongs,
Accept these gifts we offer, our service and our songs.

sections.name: Verse 5
lines: And lest the world go hungry while we ourselves are fed,
Make each of us more ready to share our daily bread.
